title: CaptureRecord
description: One raw item from the multi-source scrubber or transcriber. Written by Stage 1, consumed by Stage 2.

source_id.description: Stable, deduplicated identifier. SHA256 of (canonical_uri || normalized_first_kb) truncated to 16 hex chars.

event_ts.description: When the event happened in the wild. UTC, ISO 8601.

as_of_ts.description: When this pipeline first had the data available. UTC, ISO 8601. Stage 5 must filter `as_of_ts <= simulated_now`.

ingestion_run_id.description: Run ID that captured this. UUIDv7 preferred for sortable provenance.

uri.description: Canonical URL or URN of the source.

raw_path.description: Filesystem path relative to repo root where the raw bytes live, e.g. raw/x/<source_id>.md

content_hash.description: SHA256 of the canonical raw bytes for dedup and tamper-detect.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of the dominant content.

author.description: Author handle or name when identifiable.

credibility_tier.description: 0 = unknown, 5 = top tier (peer-reviewed paper, named CEO statement). Source of the credibility multiplier in Stage 4.

fetch_metadata.description: Free-form metadata from the fetcher (HTTP status, retry count, scraper version, etc.).
